understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the '+' goal gem by navigating horizontally through the tile grid and using gravity-driven falls to progress through the level.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT change horizontal position, after which the player automatically falls in the current gravity direction until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity was DOWN in this attempt, with falling toward smaller y values. CLICK targets and removes clickable breakable blocks without moving the player, allowing blocked fall paths to open. Landing on spikes causes failure, while safe support tiles permit landing. UNDO reverts the previous action and can recover from a mistaken move or click.
